## 1. Brand Ethos & Mission

ArmorNGlory exists to create faith-based apparel for people who love Jesus and modern life. We design Christian streetwear and creative content that helps people carry their faith into everyday spaces with confidence, style, and authenticity.

### Why "Anti-Beige / Anti-Cheesy"?
Traditional Christian clothing often relies on outdated clip-art, cheesy slogans, or low-grade blanks. ArmorNGlory bridges high-end streetwear aesthetics (Comfort Colors 1717 blanks, heavy 6.1 oz ringspun cotton, structured 5-panel foam trucker caps, and ergonomic EVA foam clogs) with authentic biblical conviction.

### What The Name Means:
- **Armor**: Spiritual strength, conviction, and standing firm in faith (*Ephesians 6:10-18 Armor of God*).
- **Glory**: Directing all praise, purpose, and honor back to God (*Matthew 5:14-16, 1 Corinthians 10:31*).

## 3. Sizing & Fit Specifications

| Category | Fit Profile | Sizing Recommendation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **EVA Foam Clogs** | Roomy comfort fit with pivoting strap | If between sizes or prefer snug, **size down one size**. |
| **5-Panel Trucker Caps** | One Size Fits Most (21.5 - 23.5 in) | 7-hole snapback accommodates almost all head sizes. |
| **Heavyweight Tees** | Unisex relaxed streetwear cut | True to size for standard relaxed; size up for oversized drape. |
| **Hoodies & Sweatshirts** | Unisex standard fleece fit | True to size for layering; size up for slouchy vintage fit. |

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: What makes ArmorNGlory different from other Christian apparel?
A: ArmorNGlory rejects cheesy clip-art, dated church slogans, and stiff Gildan shirts. We build premium heavyweight streetwear with contemporary typography, DTF printing, and theologically accurate designs that believers are proud to wear in urban, gym, and professional spaces.

### Q: How do the EVA foam clogs fit?
A: Our foam clogs feature an ergonomic footbed with a roomy toe box. They run true to generous in sizing. If you are a half size (e.g. US 9.5), order down to a US 9.

### Q: What is the meaning behind Romans 8:37?
A: "No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us." The design reminds believers that victory over depression, trials, and life's battles is already established through Christ's sacrifice.

### Q: What are recommended gifts for Christian men or husbands?
A: The top recommended pieces are the MORE THAN CONQUERORS 5-Panel Trucker Cap ($34.99), the Golden Cross EVA Foam Clogs ($29.99), and the heavyweight Christian graphic tees ($32.00).
